body_markdown:
**WINCHESTER, Va., October 20, 2026** – The executive leadership of[Trex Company](https://www.trex.com/) \[NYSE: TREX\], the world’s largest manufacturer of wood-alternative decking and railing, and a leading brand of high-performance, low-maintenance outdoor living products, will ring The Opening Bell® at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) today to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the company’s founding. The celebration recognizes three decades of innovation and growth that started with one category-defining invention and continues to redefine the future of outdoor living.


Established in 1996, Trex has evolved from a single-product manufacturer into a global outdoor living company, expanding its portfolio to help homeowners create beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces. Today, the company offers a growing range of solutions designed to transform the backyard into a seamless extension of the home.


“Ringing the Opening Bell is a special way to recognize the people, partnerships and culture of innovation that have shaped Trex over the past 30 years,” said Adam Zambanini, President and Chief Executive Officer of Trex Company. “Our founders challenged the status quo by creating a better alternative to wood, and that entrepreneurial spirit continues to define us. As we celebrate this milestone, we’re also looking ahead to an exciting new chapter and our opportunity to become the defining brand in outdoor living.”


Joining Zambanini on the podium at the New York Stock Exchange will be members of Trex’s executive leadership team.


**Celebrating 30 Years of Innovation**


In 1996, four executives from Mobil’s Composite Products Division decided to take a breakthrough technology – composite decking made from recycled plastic film and industrial wood scrap – and form a new company. The business ultimately became known as Trex Company and established an entirely new category of outdoor living products. Over the past 30 years, Trex has grown into a global outdoor living company and one of the[largest recyclers of plastic film in North America](https://www.trex.com/why-trex/sustainability/) – transforming more than 6.4 billion pounds of plastic film into beautiful and durable deck boards.


Trex debuted on the NYSE in 1999 and currently markets a[portfolio](https://www.trex.com/products/) that extends beyond decking and railing to include fencing, deck drainage, lighting, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, furniture, lattice and other outdoor living accessories. The company employs nearly 2,000 people worldwide, operates manufacturing facilities in Virginia, Nevada and Arkansas, and distributes products through more than 6,700 retail locations across six continents.


**Looking Ahead**


The Opening Bell ceremony comes as Trex enters its next era of growth, with a vision to become the defining brand in outdoor living and grow the business to $2 billion in annual revenue by 2030. The company’s strategy centers on continued investment in manufacturing capacity, product innovation, strategic partnerships and digital solutions designed to make working with Trex a seamless experience for customers, contractors and consumers.


“We’ve spent 30 years earning the trust of homeowners, contractors and channel partners by consistently delivering innovation and performance,” noted Zambanini. “We’re proud of what we’ve accomplished, but we’re even more excited about what comes next. Our opportunity extends far beyond the deck, and we are investing to lead the future of outdoor living with innovative, sustainable solutions that make it easier than ever for homeowners to create the backyard of their dreams.”


For more information, visit[Trex.com](https://www.trex.com/) .

**About Trex Company, Inc.**


For more than 30 years, Trex Company \[NYSE: TREX\] has invented, reinvented and defined the wood-alternative decking category. Today, the company is the world’s #1 brand of premium, sustainable, wood-alternative decking and railing, and a leader in high-performance, low-maintenance outdoor living products. Boasting the industry’s strongest distribution network, Trex sells products through more than 6,700 retail outlets across six continents. Through strategic licensing agreements, the company offers a comprehensive outdoor living portfolio that includes deck drainage, flashing tapes, outdoor kitchen components, pergolas, spiral stairs, lattice, cornhole and outdoor furniture – all marketed under the Trex® brand.


Based in Winchester, Va., Trex is proud to have been named[America’s Most Trusted® Outdoor Decking](https://www.lifestoryresearch.com/2025-best-decking-ranking-review) ^ for the past 6 years (2021-2026) and included in[TIME’s list of “America’s Best Companies 2026](https://time.com/article/2026/07/09/americas-best-companies-2026/) , Newsweek’s list of the[Most Trustworthy Companies in America 2026](https://www.trex.com/our-company/press/trex-named-one-of-america-s-most-trustworthy-companies-by-newswe/) and USA Today’s 2026 list of “[America’s Climate Leaders](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2026/04/20/americas-climate-leaders-2026-list/89604420007/) .” The company has also been ranked on Barron’s list of the[100 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies](https://www.barrons.com/lists-rankings/top-sustainable-companies?page=1&) (2024 and 2025), was named one of[America’s Most Responsible Companies 2024](https://www.newsweek.com/rankings/americas-most-responsible-companies-2024) by Newsweek, highlighted as one of the[100 Best ESG Companies](https://www.investors.com/news/esg-stocks-list-of-100-best-esg-companies/) by Investor’s Business Daily, and named the[Sustainable Brand Leader](https://www.greenbuildermedia.com/blog/2025-sustainable-brand-index) in the decking category by Green Builder Media for 16 consecutive years. For more information, visit[Trex.com](http://www.trex.com/) .
